kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتثاءب (form VI)
# نَتَثَاءَبُ (nataṯāʔabu) /na.ta.θaː.ʔa.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَثَاءَبَ (taṯāʔaba)
# نَتَثَاءَبَ (nataṯāʔaba) /na.ta.θaː.ʔa.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَثَاءَبَ (taṯāʔaba)
# نَتَثَاءَبْ (nataṯāʔab) /na.ta.θaː.ʔab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَثَاءَبَ (taṯāʔaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
